# /llms.txt - Lumière East Brand & Catalog Knowledge Base

> LUMIÈRE EAST: Where East Meets West — Mulberry Silk Accessories
> Designed in Ontario, Canada. Hand-rolled 100% Grade 6A Mulberry Silk & 70% Wool / 30% Silk Blends.

## 1. Brand Identity & Contact
- Brand: LUMIÈRE EAST
- Slogan: Where East Meets West
- Core Category: Mulberry Silk Accessories
- Contact: info@lumiereeast.com | +1 (647) 539-1023
- Origin: Designed in Ontario, Canada | Artisan sericulture origin

## 2. Brand Philosophy
LUMIÈRE EAST unites the radiance of Western refinement with thousands of years of sericulture history preserved in the East. Conceived and designed in Ontario, Canada, every scarf begins with Grade 6A long-fiber mulberry silk, hand-rolled hems, and fine landscape hues.

## 3. Product Catalog & Standard Specifications
Standard Dimensions: 70 x 70 cm (27.56 x 27.56 in)
Hemming: Artisan hand-rolled and hand-sewn edges
Packaging: Rigid keepsake gift box & matching gift bag included
Price: CAD $49.00 / USD $35.00

## 4. Care & Washing Protocols
- Hand wash cold in water below 30°C using pH-neutral silk detergent.
- Do not wring or soak. Roll in dry cotton towel to absorb moisture.
- Dry flat away from direct heat and sunlight. Iron reverse side on silk setting.
